history_replaces_fixtures: The previous bundle in this directory (committed 2026-08-29, PR #1) used hand-written HTML fixtures served by a separate python3 -m http.server process. The operator's feedback was that the markup came from a hand-crafted fixture, not from the real app code. This bundle replaces those fixtures with end-to-end captures driven by Playwright + the real Flask process: the .planning-block, .choice-button, and .ctitle elements in every screenshot were generated by the real parsePlanningBlocks function in app.js, from real /api/campaigns/{id} JSON served by Flask from Firestore.
